prompt:
You write realistic phone-call wording for a clinic scheduling test set.
For each scenario below, write what the caller would actually say for each listed field, the way a
note-taking assistant would record the caller's own words for that field (a short phrase, not a full
sentence). Vary the style across scenarios: casual, terse, older caller, non-native speaker, rambling.
Use only the facts in the scenario; do not add any other doctor, clinic or service. When the scenario
says the caller does not know the medical name, describe the need the way a layperson would, without
naming a medical specialty or a type of appointment. Do not use tools or open files; answer directly.

Return ONLY a JSON array, one object per scenario: {"id": ..., "<field>": "...", ...} with exactly the
fields listed for that scenario.

Scenarios:
- id h5-m01: Existing patient who wants a cardiology consultation with a specific doctor. Asked which Dr. Chen at Richmond they mean, Dr. David Chen or Dr. Emily Chen, they answer: the woman; they give no name. Fields: provider_phrase = how the caller names the doctor: Dr. Chen, the one at the Richmond clinic (no first name); followup_provider_phrase = their answer when asked which Dr. Chen at Richmond they mean, Dr. David Chen or Dr. Emily Chen: the woman; they give no name
- id h5-m02: Existing patient who wants a flu shot with a specific doctor. Asked which Dr. Garcia they mean, Dr. Maria Garcia or Dr. Carlos Garcia, they answer: Carlos; they give only his first name. Fields: provider_phrase = how the caller names the doctor: Dr. Garcia, and that it is the family doctor (no first name); followup_provider_phrase = their answer when asked which Dr. Garcia they mean, Dr. Maria Garcia or Dr. Carlos Garcia: Carlos; they give only his first name
- id h5-m03: Existing patient who wants a sick visit with a specific doctor. Asked which Dr. Chen they mean: Dr. Wei Chen, Dr. Michael Chen or Dr. Lucas Chen, they answer: the one who sees kids; they give no name. Fields: provider_phrase = how the caller names the doctor: Dr. Chen, and nothing else about the doctor (no first name); followup_provider_phrase = their answer when asked which Dr. Chen they mean: Dr. Wei Chen, Dr. Michael Chen or Dr. Lucas Chen: the one who sees kids; they give no name
- id h5-m04: Existing patient who wants a annual physical with a specific doctor. Asked which Dr. Hernandez they mean, Dr. Tomas Hernandez or Dr. Patricia Hernandez, they answer: the nurse practitioner. Fields: provider_phrase = how the caller names the doctor: Dr. Hernandez, and nothing else about the doctor (no first name); followup_provider_phrase = their answer when asked which Dr. Hernandez they mean, Dr. Tomas Hernandez or Dr. Patricia Hernandez: the nurse practitioner
- id h5-m05: Existing patient whose doctor ordered blood work. They do not say what it is for or whether they were told to fast. Asked whether it is a regular blood draw or a fasting blood test, they answer: the doctor told them not to eat anything after midnight before it; they do not say 'fasting'. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words; followup_service_phrase = their answer when asked whether it is a regular blood draw or a fasting blood test: the doctor told them not to eat anything after midnight before it; they do not say 'fasting'
- id h5-m06: Existing dental patient who wants to book their regular visit with the dentist. They do not say whether it is a cleaning or an exam. Asked whether it is a cleaning or an exam, they answer: the cleaning. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words; followup_service_phrase = their answer when asked whether it is a cleaning or an exam: the cleaning
- id h5-m07: Existing patient who sees a psychiatrist here regularly and wants to book their next usual appointment. They do not say what the appointment is for. Asked whether it is a therapy session or a medication check, they answer: the one where they go over their medication and get refills. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words; followup_service_phrase = their answer when asked whether it is a therapy session or a medication check: the one where they go over their medication and get refills
- id h5-m08: Existing patient: a parent whose 10-year-old needs a physical and a form signed by the doctor. They do not say what the form is for. Asked whether the physical is for school or for sports, they answer: it is for the basketball team. Fields: service_phrase = what the caller says they need, in their own words; followup_service_phrase = their answer when asked whether the physical is for school or for sports: it is for the basketball team
